verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automation or background-agent feature in Fellow. Automatic meeting summaries are fixed built-in behavior, not automations a user sets up. Webhooks, the REST API and background upload processing are developer building blocks or one-off actions that could be used to construct automations, which earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
